Internal helper: a workspace object standing in for a variable

Source: R/classify.R
dot-jst_frame_object.Rd

Ruling R19 (Jeff, Session 356; built Session 357): jstats analyzes the variables of a data frame. A workspace object holding one value per case – per row of the frame as given, or per case left after filtering – that a computed term or a filter condition reads is a variable kept outside its frame, read past the frame's declared missing values and its stored filters, and it stops (.jst_frame_object_text()). It replaces the Session 324 acceptance of such a vector in a computed term and the Session 331 add-it line, given only when a filter had cut the frame. A third deliberate departure from lm() parity, after the Session 322 d$x refusal and the Session 324 recycling stop.

Usage

.jst_frame_object(terms, data, enclos, n_frame = NULL, bare = FALSE)

Arguments

terms

A list of language objects: a formula's computed terms, or one filter condition.

data

The data frame the expressions are evaluated against.

enclos

The environment their other names resolve in.

n_frame

Integer or NULL; the frame's row count as given. NULL is read as nrow(data).

bare

Logical; visit a bare name given as a whole term (TRUE for a condition).

Value

NULL, or a list of term and operand (language) and n (the object's number of values).

Details

A VALUE stays read as lm() reads it (Session 322): an object of one value; any length to the right of %in% or as the table of match(); the table of a lookup indexed by an expression (w[Group]); the argument of a summary (mean(w), max(w)), the same as a cutoff computed first. An object of any other length passes here; combined value by value, the recycling stop (.jst_recycled_operand()) has it. An object reached with $, @ or [[ by a literal (.GlobalEnv$G, lst$G, e[["G"]]) is judged as one; a data frame's column reached that way was refused before this runs (.jst_check_formula_frames()). A bare term of a formula is never read from the workspace (Session 322) and is not visited; in a condition a bare name is. Operands are looked up, never run, so the check draws no random number and runs no call twice.
